name: Use pytket to build a 6-qubit circuit of 2 layers (H + CX ladder + RZ), then opt
task_prompt: Use pytket to build a 6-qubit circuit of 2 layers (H + CX ladder + RZ), then optimize it with FullPeepholeOptimise and rebase to {CX, Rz, H}. Print gate counts before and after. The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
